row.body: A key is wrapped in a request for help; the dispatch copy says the occupant was contacted before the caller’s time is recorded.
row.title: Help at the address

sidecar.gloss: A contact is marked complete before the caller’s entry.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field office might have logged an ordinary visit early; the copy does not establish whether anyone received help.

row.body: the packet of tissues and first-aid kit were sealed together but never opened. soot darkens the bundle; clean outlines show it was packed before the fire.
row.title: missing count beside the packet of tissues

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
